title: Honor false-valued bucket validators
problem: A supplied callable validator can have a false truth value. bucket silently replaces it with an accept-all default, admitting rejected keys and consuming input on rejected lookups.
expected: Use the supplied validator regardless of its truth value. Only None selects the accept-all default. Rejected selection and membership must not consume the source; key iteration must honor validation. Ordinary truthy validators and the default must retain their documented behavior.
artifact_policy: Public specifications, checks, controls and sanitized generation records. Expected answers withheld from provider requests; public historical tasks are not uncontaminated benchmarks.
ordinary_scope: Existing applicable upstream tests, byte-for-byte at the pinned base. Not the entire upstream suite.
